SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_binding b JOIN pf.credential k ON k.id=b.credential_id WHERE b.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.source_policy='PLATFORM' AND k.scope_type='PLATFORM' AND k.status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT u.version AS __column1, k.status AS __column2 FROM pf.user_model_credential u LEFT JOIN pf.credential k ON k.id=u.credential_id WHERE u.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND u.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND u.provider='DEEPSEEK'
SELECT 1 FROM pf.user_preference WHERE user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND key=#{key,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT id AS __column1 FROM pf.model_definition WHERE model_name='deepseek-flash' AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_definition WHERE id=#{model,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='ACTIVE' AND model_name IN ('deepseek-flash','deepseek-v4-pro')
SELECT key AS __column1, value_json AS __column2 FROM pf.user_preference WHERE user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT version AS __column1 FROM pf.user_preference_revision WHERE user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT scope_type AS __column1, space_id AS __column2, owner_user_id AS __column3 FROM pf.credential WHERE id=#{credential,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM pf.credential ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM pf.credential WHERE id=#{credentialId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='ACTIVE' AND revision=#{credentialRevision,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT manifest_hash AS __column1 FROM pf.runtime_bundle WHERE id=#{BUNDLE,jdbcType=OTHER}

choose.when: SELECT k.id,k.revision,m.model_name,m.version AS model_version,m.pricing_version,m.input_micros_per_million,m.output_micros_per_million FROM pf.user_model_credential u JOIN pf.credential k ON k.id=u.credential_id CROSS JOIN pf.model_definition m WHERE u.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND u.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.id=#{model,jdbcType=OTHER} AND k.status='ACTIVE' AND k.scope_type='USER' AND k.space_id=u.space_id AND k.owner_user_id=u.user_id AND m.status='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE OF k,u
choose.otherwise: SELECT k.id,k.revision,m.model_name,m.version AS model_version,m.pricing_version,m.input_micros_per_million,m.output_micros_per_million FROM pf.model_binding b JOIN pf.credential k ON k.id=b.credential_id JOIN pf.model_definition m ON m.id=b.model_id WHERE b.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.model_id=#{model,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.source_policy='PLATFORM' AND k.scope_type='PLATFORM' AND k.status='ACTIVE' AND m.status='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE OF k

SELECT id AS __column1, model_name AS __column2, version AS __column3 FROM pf.model_definition WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND model_name IN ('deepseek-flash','deepseek-v4-pro') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_binding b JOIN pf.credential k ON k.id=b.credential_id WHERE b.model_id=pf.model_definition.id AND b.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND b.source_policy=k.scope_type AND k.status='ACTIVE' AND (k.scope_type='PLATFORM' OR (k.space_id=b.space_id AND k.owner_user_id=b.user_id))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.user_model_credential u JOIN pf.credential k ON k.id=u.credential_id WHERE u.space_id=#{spaceId2,jdbcType=OTHER} AND u.user_id=#{userId2,jdbcType=OTHER} AND k.scope_type='USER' AND k.space_id=u.space_id AND k.owner_user_id=u.user_id AND k.status='ACTIVE')) ORDER BY model_name,id
